title: Hyperborean
html_source:
In Greek mythology the hyperboreans were a mythical people who lived far to the north of Thrace. Also used by Friedrich Nietzsche to describe the Ubermensch or Superman.

Hyperborea was also held by the ancient Greeks to be Apollo’s winter home, where he was venerated among its people. Also noting that Apollo was recognized as the God of truth, prophecy, and light (among other things), this furthers Mulligan’s character by aligning it with said aspects. (see §2 for Apollo’s association with Hyperborea)
